svg.title: 00b How ZamMove works
svg.text: Two services run on one system: booking a truck with a driver, and renting a vehicle to drive yourself. Every rule (prices, who may accept a job,
payments, availability) is checked by the server, not the phone.
From request to delivery, with two PIN checks and a 50/50 payment.
Contract, full payment and photo evidence protect both sides; a unit can never be double-booked.
handles incidents; sets the remittance rate.
Verifies rental payments, deposits and drivers’ weekly
remittances; keeps the ledger and settlements.
SMS/email and a real GCash gateway are simulated in
this prototype. GPS needs HTTPS on phones.
